# GLAD

These files were generated with GLAD 2.0.8 for OpenGL 4.6 core, C/C++, with the built-in loader disabled. GLFW supplies the function addresses through `glfwGetProcAddress`.

The generated sources retain their original license notices. Do not hand-edit them.
